name: wealth_total
q: SELECT CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as total_wealth WHERE account ~ "Assets:" AND not account ~ "Assets:RealEstate"

name: wealth_eur
q: SELECT CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as eur_value WHERE account ~ "Assets:" AND not account ~ "Assets:RealEstate"

name: wealth_usd
q: SELECT SUM(position) as usd_value WHERE account ~ "Assets:" AND currency = "USD"

name: wealth_gbp
q: SELECT SUM(position) as gbp_value WHERE account ~ "Assets:" AND currency = "GBP"

name: balances_by_account
q: SELECT account, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as balance WHERE account ~ "Assets:" GROUP BY account ORDER BY account

name: assets_last_update
q: SELECT account, CONVERT(sum(position), 'EUR') as balance, last(date) as last_update WHERE account ~ '^Assets' AND NOT account ~ '^Assets:RealEstate' GROUP BY account

name: invest_non_stocks
q: SELECT account, CONVERT(sum(position), 'EUR') as balance WHERE account ~ '^Assets:Invest:' AND NOT account ~ ':Stocks:' AND NOT account = 'Assets:Invest:Revolut:InvestWallet' GROUP BY account

name: stock_positions
q: SELECT account, currency(units(position)) as ticker, number(units(position)) as shares, number(cost(position)) as cost_basis WHERE account ~ '^Assets:Invest:Stocks' ORDER BY account

name: uncategorised_count
q: SELECT COUNT(*) as count WHERE account ~ "Expenses:Uncategorised" OR account ~ "Expenses:Uncategorized"

name: liabilities_payments
q: SELECT date, account, payee, CONVERT(position, 'EUR') as payment_amount, narration WHERE account ~ "^Liabilities:" AND number > 0 ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 500

name: recent_expenses_90d
q: SELECT payee, CONVERT(position, 'EUR') as amount WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' AND date >= date_add(today(), -90)

name: expenses_yearly_by_root
q: SELECT root(account, 2) AS account, year(date) as date, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') as value WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' AND NOT "exclude" IN tags AND year(date) >= 2020 GROUP BY account, date ORDER BY date, value DESC

name: food_monthly
q: SELECT root(account, 2) AS account, yearmonth(date) as date, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') AS value WHERE (account ~ 'Expenses:Groceries' OR account ~ 'Expenses:Restaurants') AND NOT "exclude" IN tags AND year(date) >= 2020 GROUP BY account, date ORDER BY date DESC, account

name: expenses_monthly_root
q: SELECT root(account, 2) AS account, yearmonth(date) as date, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') AS value WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' AND NOT "exclude" IN tags AND year(date) >= 2020 GROUP BY account, date ORDER BY date DESC, value DESC

name: expenses_last_365d
q: SELECT root(account, 2) AS account, yearmonth(date) as month, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') AS amount WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' AND NOT "exclude" IN tags AND date >= date_add(today(), -365) GROUP BY account, month ORDER BY month DESC

name: income_monthly
q: SELECT year, month, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') AS value WHERE account ~ '^Income' AND year(date) >= 2020 GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC

name: expenses_monthly_ym
q: SELECT year, month, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR') AS value WHERE account ~ '^Expenses' AND year(date) >= 2020 GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC

name: balance_series_account
q: SELECT yearmonth(date) as date, CONVERT(balance, 'EUR') as balance WHERE account = "Assets:Boursorama:Checking" ORDER BY date ASC

name: networth_buckets
q: SELECT account, getitem(open_meta(account), 'bucket') AS bucket, CONVERT(SUM(position), 'EUR', 2025-12-31) AS amt WHERE account ~ '^Assets:' AND date <= 2025-12-31 GROUP BY account, bucket ORDER BY account

name: probe_root
q: SELECT root(account, 2) as r, COUNT(*) as n WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' GROUP BY r ORDER BY r

name: probe_yearmonth
q: SELECT yearmonth(date) as ym, COUNT(*) as n WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' AND year(date) >= 2024 GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

name: probe_open_meta
q: SELECT account, getitem(open_meta(account), 'bucket') as bucket WHERE account ~ '^Assets:' GROUP BY account, bucket ORDER BY account

name: probe_tags_exclude
q: SELECT COUNT(*) as n WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' AND NOT "exclude" IN tags

name: probe_date_add_today
q: SELECT COUNT(*) as n WHERE date >= date_add(today(), -365)
